posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Certainly.

Fanatic, Tach and Crono vs. a villain with DR1 and no damage boosts, this could be fun.

I'm guessing the scenario involves Iron Legacy timeline heroes finding out that Omnitron is running the prison, doing experiments on the prisoners to improve ideas on how to fight superhumans, or use them or something.

I'm thinking Crono is involved in bringing the whole thing together and Fanatic is inside and they rescue her before they face down Omnitron.  As an Alien Tempest might have more trouble getting into and out of the Block than others, and Golem Unity might not be the best hero to bring against a dominating super evil compter.

That's my thoughts on the setting, anyone else?
